description: Asked whether the pie was a word or a thing, and got both answers kept apart.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Was not in the room. The lines were addressed to her and not answered by her.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Refused a play she had not seen and took the threepence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Wrote four plain lines and stopped.
name: William Shakespeare
